events.name: CellClick
events.description: Raised when any part of a cell is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.RowIndex and e.ColumnIndex identify the cell. RowIndex or ColumnIndex is -1 for a header.
events.useCase: Show the details of the clicked row.

events.name: CellValueChanged
events.description: Raised when a cell's value changes and the edit is committed.
events.argumentsNote: e.RowIndex and e.ColumnIndex identify the cell whose value changed.
events.useCase: Recalculate a total or mark the row as modified.

events.name: CellEndEdit
events.description: Raised when the user finishes editing a cell.
events.argumentsNote: e.RowIndex and e.ColumnIndex identify the cell that was edited.
events.useCase: Validate the new value and show an error icon in the cell.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.description: Raised when the selected cells or rows change.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Enable Delete and Edit buttons only when a row is selected.

events.name: DataError
events.description: Raised when the grid cannot convert or display a value, for example text typed into a number column.
events.argumentsNote: e.Exception describes the problem, e.RowIndex / e.ColumnIndex locate it, and e.ThrowException = false suppresses the default error dialog.
events.useCase: Show a friendly message instead of the default exception dialog.

events.name: CellFormatting
events.description: Raised just before a cell is painted, so you can change how its value looks.
events.argumentsNote: e.Value is the value being shown, e.CellStyle can be changed, e.FormattingApplied = true says you formatted it yourself.

events.name: CurrentChanged
events.description: Raised when the current item changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show the details of the current record.

events.name: PositionChanged
events.description: Raised when the Position property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.

events.name: ListChanged
events.description: Raised when the underlying list or one of its items changes.
events.argumentsNote: e.ListChangedType says what happened (ItemAdded, ItemDeleted, ItemChanged, Reset...) and e.NewIndex where.
events.useCase: Refresh totals or counters when records are added or removed.

events.name: DataSourceChanged
events.description: Raised when the DataSource property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Rebuild controls that depend on the data source.

events.name: RefreshItems
events.description: Raised when the navigator refreshes the state of its buttons, for example when the position or the count changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Update other controls to match the navigator.
